title: MTBC members as an encyclopedia pack
dek: Wikipedia lists human- and animal-adapted ecotypes under one complex. The list is a graph. RD barcodes and SNPs still do the naming in the lab.
story: Wikipedia's Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex page (Q5779917) is a membership list: M. tuberculosis, M. africanum, M. bovis, M. caprae, M. microti, M. pinnipedii, M. orygis, M. mungi, M. suricattae, M. canettii at the edge. That list is the right shape for a concept map.

What the encyclopedia will not do is replace an RD/SNP barcode. Xpert still says MTBC. BCG still deletes RD1. M. bovis still carries intrinsic pncA PZA resistance. Those are existing Simplfy plates; this card is the roster they sit under.

Animal-adapted names matter because they leak into human NAAT-positive specimens (unpasteurised dairy, BCG instillation, zoonotic orygis). A membership list is how you remember to ask the species question.
deep: M. canettii is the recombination-competent outlier; do not force it through an H37Rv-only DST pipeline without looking at the tree.
Lineages L1–L9 are a human-adapted overlay, not extra species on the Wikipedia infobox.
M. pinnipedii and M. mungi are real MTBC members you will almost never see in a pulmonary clinic; they still light some MTBC assays.
The clinic plate tb-mtbc already teaches RD9/RD1 logic. This page is the labeled pack those deletions partition.

visual.caption: Encyclopedia roster of the complex. Human-adapted names are the usual pulmonary object; animal/vaccine leaves share NAATs and not the PZA story.

example.title: Orygis on a membership list
example.setup: A WGS pipeline reports M. orygis from a pulmonary specimen. Wikipedia lists orygis as MTBC. The cartridge was MTB detected, RIF not detected.

steps.title: Believe the roster
steps.body: Orygis is MTBC, so the NAAT is not a false positive by species.

steps.title: Do not copy Mtb DST priors blindly
steps.body: Animal-adapted ecotypes can differ in intrinsic resistances and in how well an H37Rv catalogue transfers.

steps.title: Report the ecotype
steps.body: The clinical sentence starts with the name, then RIF, then PZA if pncA says so.

example.takeaway: The encyclopedia pack tells you the name is legal. The barcode tells you which name.

check.prompt: Wikipedia lists M. bovis inside MTBC. A bovine isolate is therefore:
choices: MTBC and able to trigger many MTB NAATs, while remaining a different ecotype from Mtb sensu stricto
Outside the Xpert target by definition
check.answer: MTBC and able to trigger many MTB NAATs, while remaining a different ecotype from Mtb sensu stricto

check.prompt: RD1 deleted, RD9 deleted, pncA BCG/bovis allele. Which Wikipedia roster slot is most consistent?
check.why: RD1 loss is the BCG signature; RD9 loss is animal-adapted; avium is NTM; canettii keeps a different accessory genome.

check.prompt: On the roster hierarchy, why is BCG on the edge/vaccine row rather than under human-adapted L1–L9?
choices: Because it is an RD1-deleted M. bovis derivative, not a human-adapted Mtb lineage
Because Wikipedia does not mention BCG
check.answer: Because it is an RD1-deleted M. bovis derivative, not a human-adapted Mtb lineage
check.why: The figure is an ecotype roster.

whyWrong.Because Wikipedia does not mention BCG: It does; this card links that page.
